unique_findings: toggleCard() ORDER-OF-CHECKS BUG: it must still allow CLOSING an already-open card whose key later falls out of cardWidgets(). The closed DEV-2409 branch had to fix exactly this. If cardWidgets() narrows to expandableCards() without that guard, a card that becomes locked while open can never be closed.

PRODUCT REGRESSION: moving Kit Users to a header stat LOSES its click-to-expand table (KitUsers::table(), the list of currently-active kit names). HotlistCount header stats are not expandable today. The ticket does not say whether that interactive list needs a new home.
No FeatureEnum / ProTierEnum entry exists for ANY of today's 7 cards -- so canViewCardData() returning true for all 7 is correct and this ticket ships NO visible locked card in production.
The closed branch's DashboardCardVisibilityTest.php proves the gate runs BEFORE any value is computed, via a CACHE-LEAK test -- strong design reference for AC-4's 'shows no value'.
